1256.name: Neutralizing Gas
1256.description: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

1257.name: Pastel Veil
1257.description: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from being poisoned.

1258.name: Hunger Switch
1258.description: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.

1259.name: Quick Draw
1259.description: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

1260.name: Unseen Fist
1260.description: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itsPokemon.

1261.name: Curious Medicine
1261.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

1263.name: Dragon’s Maw
1263.description: If a Dragon-type move is used by a Pokémon with this Ability, its Attack or Special Attack stat is multiplied by 1.5 during damage calculation, effectively increasing damage dealt by 50%.

1264.name: Chilling Neigh
1264.description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

1265.name: Grim Neigh
1265.description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

1266.name: As One
1266.description: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Glastrier's Chilling Neigh Ability.

1267.name: As One
1267.description: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Glastrier's Chilling Neigh Ability.

1268.name: Lingering Aroma
1268.description: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

1269.name: Seed Sower
1269.description: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

1270.name: Thermal Exchange
1270.description: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

1271.name: Anger Shell
1271.description: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

1272.name: Purifying Salt
1272.description: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

1273.name: Well-Baked Body
1273.description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

1274.name: Wind Rider
1274.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

1275.name: Guard Dog
1275.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

1277.name: Wind Power
1277.description: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

1278.name: Zero to Hero
1278.description: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.

1279.name: Commander
1279.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.

1280.name: Electromorphosis
1280.description: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

1281.name: Protosynthesis
1281.description: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

1282.name: Quark Drive
1282.description: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

1283.name: Good as Gold
1283.description: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.

1284.name: Vessel of Ruin
1284.description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itsPokemon.

1285.name: Sword of Ruin
1285.description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itsPokemon.

1286.name: Tablets of Ruin
1286.description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itsPokemon.

1287.name: Beads of Ruin
1287.description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itsPokemon.

1288.name: Orichalcum Pulse
1288.description: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

1289.name: Hadron Engine
1289.description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

1290.name: Opportunist
1290.description: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itsPokemon.

1291.name: Cud Chew
1291.description: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

1293.name: Supreme Overlord
1293.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

1294.name: Costar
1294.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.

1295.name: Toxic Debris
1295.description: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

1296.name: Armor Tail
1296.description: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

1297.name: Earth Eater
1297.description: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

1298.name: Mycelium Might
1298.description: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

1299.name: Dark Weather
1299.description: When the Pokemon appears, the weather turns dark until the Pokemon exits

1300.name: Body of Darkness
1300.description: Halve damage and reduce hit by 20% for attacks that Dark-type.

1301.name: Pressure
1301.description: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.

1302.name: Zen Mode
1302.description: Changes the Pokémon's shape when its HP drops to half or less.

1303.name: Supersweet Syrup
1303.description: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field the first time the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.

1304.name: Hospitality
1304.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP.

1305.name: Toxic Chain
1305.description: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move.

1306.name: Embody Aspect
1306.description: Upon Terastallizing, Ogerpon's Ability will change to Embody Aspect, and one of its stats is raised by one stage, depending on the mask

1307.name: Tera Shift
1307.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itsPokemon and transforms into its Terastal Form.

1308.name: Poison Puppeteer
1308.description: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.

1309.name: Confrontational drama
1309.description: When facing the opposite sex, its own speed level is +1; when facing the same sex, its special attacks level is +1; when facing the opposite sex, its speed and special attacks level are both +1.

1310.name: Fear
1310.description: When attacked by fire moves or sound moves, you will fall into a state of Flinch, and your speed level will increase by 2 levels.

1311.name: Loose seal
1311.description: When HP is less than half, the thunder bell seal will be invalid, and the annual meeting will become evening. When attacked by fire moves or sound moves, it will fall into a state of shrinking, and the speed level will be increased by 1 level.

1312.name: Dark airflow
1312.description: Into weather that makes the weakness of ghost attributes disappear.

1313.name: nirvana and rebirth
1313.description: After dying for the first time, he was directly resurrected in a state of 60% HP and entered a state of nirvana. Nirvana: +2 for each resurrection attack, the lower the blood volume, the higher the power of the move.

1314.name: Tera Shell
1314.description: Ability Effect: When a Pokémon with this ability has full HP, if it is hit by a move with a type effectiveness of 1x or higher, the move’s effectiveness will be reduced to "not very effective" (0.5x).

1315.name: Sun Wheel Guardian
1315.description: Will not be reduced in ability due to the opponent's moves or characteristics, and has an autoimmune effect: dot damage caused by poisoning, toxicity, burning,Dark Weather and binding

1316.name: Moon Moon Protection
1316.description: The Pok é mon with this feature has the ability to ignore changes in the target's attack, special attack, and hit rate when launching moves with an unsatisfactory effect of 1.5 damage.

1317.name: Neuroforce
1317.description: Powers up the Pokémon's supereffective attacks even further.

1318.name: Starry Clear Domain
1318.description: When Kira Qi enters, clear all the enemy's current Pok é mon buff effects, and trigger up to one battle

1319.name: Wishing for blessings and protection
1319.description: When Kira Qi is in a dying state for the first time, she falls into a deep sleep and attaches herself to the elf who has taken over from her. This elf adds a shield equivalent to 30% of Kira Qi's maximum health. When the elf's moves put the enemy elf in a dying state, she resurrects Kira Qi and refreshes all of Kira Qi's PPs

1320.name: Arctic Lord
1320.description: Changes the weather to one that removes Ice-type weaknesses, and causes opposing Water-type Pokémon to enter with Speed -2, other types with Speed -1. Ice types are unaffected.

1321.name: Earth Sovereign
1321.description: Changes the weather to one that removes the weaknesses of Ground- and Rock-type Pokémon, and causes opposing Pokémon on the field to be afflicted with the Smack Down status. When an opponent switches out, the incoming Pokémon takes severe seismic damage, losing 25% of its max HP.

1322.name: Sword & Shield Legend
1322.description: Upon entering battle for the first time, Attack and Defense are raised by 2 stages. Each subsequent turn, either Attack or Defense will be randomly raised by 1 stage.

1323.name: Piercing Drill
1323.description: When using contact moves, ignores the opponent’s protection moves and deals 25% of original damage.

1324.name: Eel Ascent
1324.description: Levitates off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves. When knocking out a Pokémon with an attacking move, raises its highest stat (excluding HP) by 1 stage.

1325.name: Flame Mane
1325.description: Pokémon with this Ability deal 1.5× damage with Fire-type moves.

1326.name: Chili Eruption
1326.description: Inflicts Burn on the foe when taking damage from a move.
